subject: Confession: I built this at 2AM
preview_text: The real reason behind our chart analyzer feature — and why it works at 3am.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM, and I was staring at a crypto chart with that familiar pit in my stomach. I'd just watched a coin rip 20% after ignoring my own rules, chasing a tweet from a guy with a Lambo avatar. Sound familiar? That night, I realized: retail traders don't need more data. They need a filter that cuts through the noise — something that tells you, 'This is the move, or this isn't.'

So I built it. Not for a VC deck or a product roadmap. Just for me, at my desk, after one too many FOMO buys. The first version was a mess of APIs and coffee stains, but it worked: upload a chart, get a clean verdict — entry, stop, target, confidence. No hype, no bias. Just math and signal.

That 2AM experiment became Crypto AI's core feature: upload any chart screenshot and get an AI verdict in seconds. It's like having a calm trading desk in your pocket, one that never chases pumps or panics at dips. It's the voice I needed that night — and it's waiting for you.
Open the app, upload your most recent chart, and see the verdict. P.S. — the AI is especially sharp on low-cap altcoins right now, where Twitter noise is loudest.
